_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Pressure and oscillations are now recorded and reported in mmHg; signed flow is in L/min. Original volts and native acquisition times are retained. Missing calibration is marked unavailable.

Simulator sweeps can run multiple selected Max targets for each settings combination. Each Max preset runs one cycle per trial with a 30-second vented break. Preview, settings CSV imports/exports, filenames and results identify each trial's protocol.

Each trial gains a simple measurements CSV and a four-panel overview at the front of its PDF: pressure, pulse/envelope, flow, and pump/valve duty. Simulator sweeps also write a short results.csv, and pulse-volume filenames explicitly use mL. Live status, Fit All, and measurement labels use their correct physical units.

This Valinor GUI update retains gauge firmware rev27v-gauge-38, the Max presets, and existing controls and calibrations. Unit conversion does not establish absolute flow accuracy or independent MAP accuracy.
